mainEntity.name: What factors have the biggest impact on the cost of adding an in-law suite?

acceptedAnswer.text: Costs vary substantially based on whether the project is an interior conversion or a structural addition, along with the plumbing and electrical work required. Adding a full bathroom with a walk-in shower and running dedicated supply lines and drains increases costs compared to a simple bedroom update. Kitchen amenities also drive expenses, especially if adding high-voltage appliance circuits or specialized cabinetry. Ground-up builds add costs for concrete slab work, framing, and matching exterior finishes such as full-house stuccoing and roofing materials. Detailed pricing is determined through an in-person consultation and estimate.
acceptedAnswer.description: Primary cost factors include building new foundation and exterior walls versus converting interior space, running new plumbing lines, and installing dedicated bathrooms and kitchens.
